authorInfo.bio: Honoré de Balzac was a French novelist and playwright. The novel sequence La Comédie humaine, described as a panorama of post-Napoleonic French life, is generally viewed as his magnum opus.

description: "The Physiology of Marriage, Complete" by Honoré de Balzac is a philosophical essay written in the early 19th century. The work explores the complexities, challenges, and societal perceptions of marriage, critically analyzing the institution from various angles, while also providing reflections on love and human relationships.
